ios.desc:
Hello Transcribe is a private and secure speech to text transcriber that uses OpenAI Whisper and Whisper.cpp.

• All processing is done on-device for 100% privacy, and it also works offline.
• Transcribe voice notes (e.g. WhatsApp), podcasts, or any audio file (many formats supported).
• Transcribe supported video formats.
• Save encrypted results in iCloud.
• Transcribe the microphone feed to dictate notes or record meetings live.
• Supports many languages and translation to English.
• [PRO] Buy PRO once off, use forever.
• [PRO] Use Presets to manage different configurations.
• [PRO] Export VTT or SRT files to add subtitles to video or podcasts.
• [PRO] Save audio to re-transcribe later or export.


Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
